parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-08 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 225.6 | 4.98 | 4.98
2 | 217.6 | 7.63 | 12.61
3 | 626.8 | 19.10 | 31.71
4 | 694.3 | 0.32 | 32.03
5 | 580.5 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-08
Curve type: HAK
Aquifer depth: 5.0 - 12.6 m (weathered layer) and > 32.0 m (fractured bedrock)
Recommendation: Drill to a target depth of 40 to 45 m to fully penetrate the shallow weathered horizon and tap into the underlying fractured basement aquifer. Install appropriate casing through the upper 13 m to stabilize the unconsolidated overburden.
